arg.name: vehicle_physics
arg.description: the vehicle spec's carla_physics.yaml on the ego and agent vehicles; none: the blueprints' own

arg.name: world_config
arg.description: the CARLA world server's config file (swb_carla_world.yaml: map_alias, traffic_manager, spectator, weather presets); empty: the installed one

arg.name: npc_contact_sensors
arg.description: true: contact sensors on the NPC vehicles too (CARLA's contacts in the verdict); empty: the world server config's

arg.name: ego_launch
arg.description: the autopilot's launch; empty: acb's Autoware profile; none: no ego

arg.name: ego_launch_args
arg.description: name:=value ... for ego_launch (the default autopilot: rviz, max_velocity, autoware_launch, ...)

arg.name: agent
arg.description: start swb's vehicle agent beside the autopilot; false: ego_launch registers its own

arg.name: vehicle_model
arg.description: the ego's vehicle model (its description's spec_hash.yaml); empty: tesla_model3

arg.name: spec_hash_file
arg.description: the agent's spec_hash YAML, instead of vehicle_model's (a car from another repository)

arg.name: vehicle_catalogs
arg.description: extra vehicle catalogs for the bridge's spec check, comma separated

arg.name: side_args
arg.description: name:=value ... for the simulation side (simulation.launch.xml: config_file, weather, gap_trace_dir, npc_motion, contact_report_dir)

arg.name: scenario
arg.description: an .xosc to run once the stack is up; empty: none

arg.name: exit_on_scenario_end
arg.description: true: the whole stack ends with the scenario (scripted runs)

arg.name: spawn
arg.description: free drive without a scenario: the ego at x,y,z,yaw (map frame)

arg.name: vehicle
arg.description: free drive: the ego's catalog entry; empty: vehicle_model

arg.name: realtime
arg.description: free drive: pace to the wall clock; false: as fast as it goes (synchronous either way)

arg.name: sim_args
arg.value: vehicle_physics:=$(var vehicle_physics) npc_contact_sensors:=$(var npc_contact_sensors) config_file:=$(var world_config)
